attachments.origin_landmark: pubic crest and the anterior pubic ligament
attachments.insertion_landmark: linea alba, partway between the pubis and the umbilicus

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Absent in roughly a fifth of people, and of no functional consequence when it is. Its lower attachment is a reliable surgical landmark for the midline in a Pfannenstiel incision.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
